Start a Quarto study

Source: vignettes/articles/study-template.Rmd
study-template.Rmd
library(easyNIS)
library(dplyr)
library(srvyr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")

The examples use invented data.

study <- nis_new_study(tempfile("nis-study-"))
list.files(study, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE)
#> [1] "_quarto.yml"  ".gitignore"   "analysis.qmd"

Install Quarto and the R packages purrr, survey, srvyr, and gtsummary. Use a new directory in a private workspace. Open analysis.qmd and render it from that directory with quarto render analysis.qmd. The template uses nis_example() while data_path is unset.

Use your annual files

In the report’s YAML, set params.data_path to the directory containing your prepared annual Parquet files. Set the years and revise the code definitions, eligibility criteria, endpoints, and analysis for your study. Render the report again. Prepare annual NIS files

Review the methods and checklist

Read the generated methods paragraph alongside the design and cohort outputs. Check the sample definition, weighting convention, and model denominators. The checklist receipt records package checks and items that need your review. Check disclosure across the rendered tables and figures before sharing the report.
